articles.headline: Jokic, Murray help Nuggets hand Pelicans a sixth straight loss
articles.description: — Nikola Jokic had 26 points, eight rebounds and 10 assists, Jamal Murray added 23 points, seven rebounds and nine assists, and the Denver Nuggets outlasted the New Orleans Pelicans 116-108 on Saturday night.

articles.description: The Cavaliers were without their entire starting lineup Saturday against the Mavericks after four players were ruled out following travel difficulties.

articles.headline: Lakers' Austin Reaves (heel bruise) to sit out vs. Suns
articles.description: Los Angeles Lakers guard Austin Reaves will not play against the Phoenix Suns on Sunday because of a left heel bruise, the team announced.

articles.headline: 76ers' Joel Embiid out vs. Pacers due to plantar fascia management
articles.description: The Philadelphia 76ers ruled out center Joel Embiid for Sunday's game against the Indiana Pacers with right foot plantar fascia management, the team announced Saturday.
